sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, sides slightly expanded forward; antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 shortest and much shorter than segment 2; labrum wider than long, anterior margin broadly rounded at the apex; mandibles long and slender, coarsely serrate, apex slightly incurved; postmentum rod-like, waist near the posterior margin; pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin with an indistinct notch.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale brown with red; antennae yellowish brown; mandibles dark reddish brown; pronotum pale yellow; abdomen yellowish white. Head with a few scattered setae; pronotal margins and body with a few hairs. Head capsule subrectangular, sides slightly expanded forward (1.44–1.54 mm to mandible bases, maximum width 0.89–0.96 mm). Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 shortest, much shorter than segment 2. Labrum wider than long, anterior margin broadly rounded at the apex. Mandibles long and slender, coarsely serrate, apex slightly incurved (left mandible length 1.03–1.07 mm). Postmentum rod-like, waist near the posterior margin (length 0.82 mm, maximum width 0.32–0.35 mm, waist width 0.18–0.20 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin with an indistinct notch, posterior margin straight or slightly concave (length 0.30–0.32 mm, width 0.57–0.65 mm).
